challenge.title: Community and Belief Evidence Challenge
challenge.description: Complete 10 activities: six clue-and-conclusion decisions and four matching tasks. Choose both the supporting clue and its conclusion for each evidence decision. Get at least 7 activities correct. All lesson clues are available without saving them in your journal.

badge.name: Community and Belief Investigator
badge.description: Earned by completing four Chapter 8 missions and passing the evidence challenge. Recognizes careful use of evidence about institutions, community life and different responses.

evidence.question: A museum label describes the 1593 Doctrina Christiana. Which clue helps decide what this teaching material proves?
choices: It provides evidence of teaching material, not every persons reading or belief
It proves every person read it
It records every private belief
It proves all communities accepted the same teaching
evidence.explanation: The dated teaching material supports a claim about production. Reading and acceptance need further evidence.

evidence.question: An arrival record is used to claim everyone converted immediately. Which clue checks that claim?
choices: An arrival record does not establish every persons conversion
An arrival proves universal agreement
All people had the same reason for participation
No other traditions existed
evidence.explanation: Keep the recorded arrival separate from a claim about every persons belief.

evidence.question: A funding promise is described as proof that resources reached their destination. Which clue should you use?
choices: Promise, delivery and actual use must be checked separately
A promise proves delivery and use
An allocation reveals every private belief
Funding means every community benefited equally
evidence.explanation: A funding promise does not by itself establish delivery or actual use.

evidence.question: A letter makes a claim about authority. Which clue checks whether this settled the dispute?
choices: A claim in a letter is not automatically a final accepted decision
Every letter is a final ruling
A dispute proves who won
Connected institutions always agreed
evidence.explanation: Distinguish a stated claim from evidence of a later decision and its effects.

evidence.question: An early parish date is attached to every feature of a later building. Which clue checks the caption?
choices: The parish beginning does not date every later building feature
Every visible feature dates to the parish beginning
A building reveals every residents beliefs
A later photograph shows every earlier appearance
evidence.explanation: An institutions beginning and the dates of its building features are different questions.

evidence.question: A report uses Tamblots case to describe every community. Which clue directly checks this leap?
choices: A named case cannot describe every community
One case gives every community the same motive
A date proves every private belief
All responses were identical everywhere
evidence.explanation: Name the case and its scope. Wider claims require evidence from other communities.

matching.question: Match each missionary-history clue with the question it helps answer.
matching.explanation: Arrival, production and a recorded event are distinct claims. None alone supplies every persons private belief.

matching.question: Match each institutional record with what it most directly describes.
matching.explanation: Check delivery, later approval and final decisions separately. A record of a proposal does not prove every later outcome.

matching.question: Match the community-history idea with its meaning.
pairs: What a person holds to be true
An organized body with continuing roles
matching.explanation: These ideas can connect, but evidence about a practice or institution does not reveal every persons belief.

matching.question: Match each tool for explaining community responses with its meaning.
pairs: What a clue does not establish
matching.explanation: Explain what changed, what continued and what remains uncertain. A response must be understood in its particular setting.
